overview_description.description: Paack is a technology-driven logistics company specializing in sustainable and efficient last-mile delivery solutions across Europe. The company helps retailers and e-commerce businesses improve delivery experiences through advanced technology, real-time tracking, optimized routes, and customer-focused services. Paack focuses on reducing environmental impact by using greener transportation methods and smarter logistics operations. Its platform enables faster, more reliable deliveries while supporting businesses in meeting growing consumer expectations for convenience, transparency, and sustainability.

product.name: Last Mile Delivery Services
product.description: Provides parcel delivery from distribution centers to customers with options for scheduled delivery times and dates.

product.name: Temperature Controlled Delivery (Paack Food)
product.description: Delivers temperature-sensitive products using refrigerated vehicles and specialized handling to maintain product quality and safety.

product.name: Scheduled Delivery Options
product.description: Offers multiple delivery timing options including Next Day, Same Day, Chosen Day, Immediate Delivery, and scheduled returns.

product.name: Returns Management Service
product.description: Manages scheduled product returns with label-free processing to simplify the return experience for customers and retailers.
